parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: the connection ID used to connect to the database

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: name of database which overwrite the defined one in connection

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: the SQL code or string pointing to a template file to be executed (templated). File must have a '.sql' extension.

parameters.name: autocommit
parameters.description: (optional) if True, each command is automatically committed (default: False).

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: (optional) the parameters to render the SQL query with.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: (optional) the function that will be applied to the cursor (default: fetch_all_handler).

parameters.name: output_processor
parameters.type: Callable[[list[Any], list[Sequence[Sequence] | None]], list[Any] | tuple[list[Sequence[Sequence] | None], list]] | None
parameters.description: (optional) the function that will be applied to the result (default: default_output_processor).

parameters.name: split_statements
parameters.description: (optional) if split single SQL string into statements. By default, defers to the default value in the ``run`` method of the configured hook.

parameters.name: return_last
parameters.description: (optional) return the result of only last statement (default: True).

parameters.name: show_return_value_in_logs
parameters.description: (optional) if true operator output will be printed to the task log. Use with caution. It's not recommended to dump large datasets to the log. (default: False).

parameters.name: requires_result_fetch
parameters.description: (optional) if True, ensures that query results are fetched before completing execution. If `do_xcom_push` is True, results are fetched automatically, making this parameter redundant. (default: False).

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Optional DB schema that overrides the schema specified in the connection. Make sure that if you change the schema parameter value in the constructor of the derived Hook, such change should be done before calling the ``DBApiHook.__init__()``.

parameters.name: log_sql
parameters.description: Whether to log SQL query when it's executed. Defaults to *True*.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional. Specifies command-line options to send to the server at connection start. For example, setting this to ``-c search_path=myschema`` sets the session's value of the ``search_path`` to ``myschema``.

parameters.name: enable_log_db_messages
parameters.description: Optional. If enabled logs database messages sent to the client during the session. To avoid a memory leak psycopg2 only saves the last 50 messages. For details, see: `PostgreSQL logging configuration parameters <https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/runtime-config-logging.html>`__
